title: Crowns of Coral
description: A miniature maritime 4X shaped by announced tides. Explore a hand-crafted archipelago, found pearl ports, research twelve technologies and win with three lighthouses or both rival capitals.
controls: Click or tap a ship, then a highlighted hex to sail
Click or tap a visible enemy in range to preview and confirm deterministic combat
Drag to pan; wheel, pinch or +/− buttons to zoom
Buttons: End turn, Research, Captain's guide, Language EN/FR/ES, Sound
credits: Designed and developed with Kimi for Kimi Games.
Original deterministic rules, local AI, trilingual interface, Blender models, GLB animations, materials, texture, isometric renders and synthesized audio.
No third-party runtime libraries or external assets.
